annotations.title: Find local businesses of one kind in one town from OpenStreetMap (name, website, phone, opening hours; credited, signed)

description: Find local businesses of one kind in one town from OpenStreetMap open data. Send kind (cafe, dentist, plumber, bakery, car repair, ... see the list in the error if yours is not known) and place (a town, suburb or district, optionally country_code like IE or US). Get up to 100 businesses, each with name, website, phone, opening hours as mapped, address, position and its OpenStreetMap link, plus a hand-off to LLPRO for the next job. Signed and dated. Free, no sign-up, 50 searches a day per caller. Businesses only (no people, no e-mail addresses); the data is volunteer-mapped, so it is incomplete and sometimes out of date, and every answer says so and carries the OpenStreetMap credit (ODbL). No model, nothing about you or your search is stored. Road: Search for agents - agents that need local business lists find this tool through the LLPRO gateway. Docs: https://llpro.ai/local-business-finder

country_code.description: Optional two-letter country code to pick the right town (IE, US, DE ...).

kind.description: Kind of business, e.g. cafe, dentist, plumber, bakery, car repair, hairdresser.

only_with.description: Keep only businesses that have all of these mapped: website, phone, opening_hours.

place.description: Town, suburb or district, e.g. Galway or 'Brooklyn, New York'. Not a whole country or state.
